'''Chapter 593''' is titled "NEWS".

==Cover Page==
[[Kuzan|Aokiji]] and [[Tsuru]] are sitting in a little boat, relaxing and eating [[Wikipedia:Onigiri|onigiris]], with a [[Sea King]] in the background, apparently very interested in their food.

==Short Summary==
Both [[Nico Robin]] and [[Sanji]] start their journeys to reunite with [[Monkey D. Luffy|their captain]], respectively with the [[Revolutionaries]]' and [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]]'s help, while the one who separated them, the [[Pacifista|cyborg]] [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]], whose situation is being discussed by Ivankov and [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]], appears before [[Shakuyaku|Shakky]], [[Hatchan]]'s group, and the [[Rosy Life Riders|Flying Fish Riders]] on [[Sabaody Archipelago]]. In the meantime, the details of some of [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s past actions are revealed, and the party [[Buggy]] is having to celebrate the reunion with his old crew is interrupted by [[Galdino|Mr. 3]], who reveals to his friend that the [[World Government]] sent a letter for him.

==Long Summary==
On [[Tequila Wolf]], [[Bunny Joe]] explains to [[Nico Robin|Robin]] that she is deemed "The Light of the Revolution" by the [[Revolutionary Army|Revolutionaries]] who saved her, who were also ordered by [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] to protect her once located. They want her to meet Dragon, but Robin says that she must reach her captain and worries about the safety of her [[Straw Hat Pirates|own crew]]. The Revolutionaries then agree to bring her back to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. During the journey, [[Karasu|a crow]] delivers a newspaper to Joe, who then gives it to Robin. She reads the latest news in the paper, in which she sees something "amusing" that made her laugh.

In the meantime, [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]] has returned to [[Momoiro Island|Kamabakka Queendom]] with [[Inazuma]] and his other subordinates. Here he meets a once again normal [[Sanji]], but refuses to believe he is part of Luffy's crew because he does not recognize Sanji's wanted poster. After arguing with the queen and getting beaten up by him, Sanji manages to learn the news regarding Luffy in a newspaper, being astonished by it. Right after speaking to Sanji, Iva is summoned via a [[Den Den Mushi]] from [[Baltigo]], by none other than Dragon himself. The two companions speak to each other for the first time in a while, their main subjects being Dragon's identity being revealed to the world, Luffy's most recent actions, and last but not least, [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]].

Kuma, who in the meantime appears before [[Shakky]], [[Hatchan]], [[Camie]], [[Pappag]], [[Duval]], and his gang, who have just prevented the [[Coffee Monkeys]] from stealing the [[Thousand Sunny]]. Shakky, believing him to still be an ally, is not afraid, unaware that the Shichibukai lost his free will and became a weapon for the [[World Government]].

[[Arabasta]] is having some problems with pirates, with [[Chaka]] and [[Pell]] reporting to [[Nefertari Cobra|King Cobra]] and [[Igaram]]. [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] is seen reading a newspaper with [[Karoo]] at her side, commenting on Luffy's still unknown action as well.

In a city on an unknown island in the [[Grand Line]], [[Crocodile]] and [[Daz Bonez|Mr. 1]] are talking about the latest news. The former Shichibukai says he is going back to the [[New World]], and he invites Daz Bonez to come with him, an offer he accepts without hesitation.

At the same time, [[Buggy]] is reunited with his [[Buggy Pirates|original crew]] on an unknown island in the Grand Line. All of his subordinates are glad to see him, and both [[Mohji]] and [[Cabaji]] confirm their status as leading crewmembers to [[Impel Down]]'s prisoners, who have joined Buggy and his old crew. [[Galdino|Mr. 3]] informs Buggy that a carrier bat brought him a message from the World Government, saying that he is not going to believe what is written on it.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*It is revealed by a [[Revolutionary Army|revolutionary]] that the construction of the bridge on [[Tequila Wolf]] was an order by the [[World Nobles]].
*[[Sanji]] returns to his old self.
*[[Inazuma]] is alive.
*[[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]]'s relationship with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has officially become public knowledge.
*[[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] speaks with [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]] about [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]].
*A white [[Den Den Mushi]] is introduced, which prevents calls from being monitored or intercepted.
*[[Crocodile]] decides to return to the [[New World]] and invites [[Daz Bonez]], who accepts the offer.
*[[Buggy]] reunites with [[Buggy Pirates|his crew]] and his [[Impel Down]] followers join the crew.
*Buggy receives a mysterious message from the [[World Government]].
